parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the content within the request and response. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:

*   **zh**: Chinese
*   **en**: English

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. Default value: 1. Pages start from page 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. If you do not specify the PageSize parameter, 10 entries are returned by default.

>  We recommend that you do not leave this parameter empty.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sophonsoar describe-playbook-releases --playbook-uuid ac343acc-1a61-4084-9a1c-xxxx --lang zh --page-size 10 --page-number 1 --api-version 2022-07-28 --region cn-hangzhou
